                                         ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITV COUNCIL OF THE CITV OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the Ml-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-A in the area bounded by

       A line 200 feet south of and parallel to East 118th Street; a line 385 feet east of and
       parallel to South Avenue O; a line 499.70 feet south of and parallel to East 118th Street;
       and South Avenue O

to those of a M2-I, Light Industry District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.




Common Address of Property: 11835 - 11901 S. Avenue O

12.   Reason for rezoning the property To comply with the Use Table and Standards for the M2 district
      for Vehicle Sales and Service. Heavv Equipment Sales, and Rentals.
13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
      units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
      height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)

      Indoor and outdoor storage for the sales, rental, service, and storage of heavy equipment. No
      residential use. Will continue to have approximatelv 25 customer and/or employee parking
      spaces. Will maintain the existing warehouse size of 21.600 square feet, with the current building
      height to remain unchanged.
14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or a
      financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
      Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      www.citvofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?
